annotations.title: Give a phone access to an app

description: Give a person access to an app by their phone number: the phone and a role, nothing else. This is how the people who run an app (the business owner, a manager, staff) get into its admin screen, whose endpoints are in row-level security mode "shared". The person needs no invite code and does not have to sign in first. If the phone already signed in to this organization with a code, access is on at once and the answer has status "active" and their userId. Otherwise the answer has status "pending" and a pendingId: nothing is created for the number yet, and the access opens by itself the first time that phone signs in to the app with an SMS code (POST /auth/otp/send, then /auth/otp/verify). The phone is matched whatever its spelling: 054-1234567, +972 54 123 4567 and 972541234567 are one number; a number outside Israel needs its country code. Calling again for the same phone sets its role again, and switches back on a user who was switched off. Roles: editor (reads and writes), viewer (reads), submitter (creates). The app must still sign people in by phone code; a person who signs in another way (email and password, Google) is a different account, give them access with set_app_user_role after their first sign-in. Requires organization owner or admin (an editor gets 403).

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

expiresInDays.description: For a phone that has not signed in yet: days the waiting access stays valid (1-365). Omit and it waits with no time limit, which is the normal choice

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

phone.description: The phone number, e.g. "0541234567" or "+972541234567"; any spelling of an Israeli mobile, or any other number with its country code

role.description: App-level access role: editor (reads and writes; the default), viewer (reads), submitter (creates)

name: add_app_user
